update_log.source: named Execute input only; new override for isolated testing of upstream constant

input_mapping.environment: No environment variable is read by business logic; native commands inherit caller PATH and environment.

behavior: Run the second native grep only when the first returns 0. Any nonzero second status prints the red warning and blank line. Every ordinary grep exit status is handled; final analyzer status is 0.
safety: Exact upstream file runs under /bin/bash with owned temporary HOME and restricted PATH. Test-only grep transport shim maps the fixed /tmp operand to an owned log, records literal argv, runs native grep, or injects selected exit statuses. The real /tmp/omarchy-update.log is never accessed. No update, package, privileged or recovery commands occur in this source.
limits: Host /bin/bash is Apple GNU Bash 3.2.57 and prints literal backslash-e for upstream echo -e. The rewrite prints intended ESC color bytes. Tests use exact separate stdout oracles for this declared host difference; statuses, stderr and native grep traces are compared exactly. BASH_TEST_BINARY may select a modern Bash, where exact warning stdout comparison is automatic.
Native grep is the host implementation (BSD on this macOS). These fixed substring patterns use compatible grep syntax; no target Arch Linux execution is claimed.
One native printf replaces two Bash built-in echo calls. Command count and spawn/signal/output-write failure details therefore differ; normal output includes precisely two trailing newlines.
Execute treats signal, spawn, I/O, timeout and output-limit failures as interpreter failures; captured ordinary grep exit statuses preserve upstream conditional semantics.
No new Execute grammar was needed.
